_doc: Owned per-state wear weights (wear.py), the Second Wind's scale: 0 = none, 1 = its derelict ceiling. The Falcon (P) as a pirate flagship: hard-used, patched and never properly repainted, but kept fighting. Heavier abrasion, grime and soot than any navy hull; some neglect (plates in the wrong shade, bare primer) to go with the patch slabs the geometry already bolts on.
